entries.prompt: Correct ONLY the residual wearer dreadlocks that have been mistakenly rendered as metallic side columns in the SECOND isolated PHG2019preview photo06 mask. FIRST official preview photo06 is the source authority. Remove the vertical segmented exterior rows BEHIND the temples: image-left narrow beaded/stacked strip behind the three-red-point fitting,and image-right narrow segmented strip behind the outer cheek. These correspond to wearer dreads/hair rings seen behind the actual mask in FIRST,not new mask plates. Stop at and preserve the real hard shell silhouette/temple edge; keep all actual FRONT cheek plates,curved bands and muzzle ridges intact. Do not remove the true upper metallic rim with its two rising tips and central dark domed lobe: those belong to the mask. Keep exactly the existing source THREE red physical lens points in same image-left triangle. Keep every other part of SECOND unchanged: camera/downward tilt,projected proportions,whole crown/eye/muzzle architecture,opaque dark optics,actual silver/green-gray material with source local lighting,wear and all true facial relief. No new front/profile/back,hidden geometry,vents,runes,extra lenses or hardware. Genuine transparent RGBA where excluded hair columns were,with clear empty alpha around actual mask. Exclude all biological skin/eyes/mandibles,dreads/hair rings,neck/body/armor/scene. Exactly one complete isolated hard mask,10percent clear transparent margins,crown tips and chin entirely visible,longest axis78-80percent canvas,no background,floor,shadow plane,glow,text or UI. Only remove the two exterior hair-derived strips; do not crop or reshape the real mask.
